what.en: The street address of the food facility itself, with suite or unit. Not a mailing, head-office or overseas address, and not a P.O. box. Include street directions and suite.
what.zh: 填写食品设施本身的街道地址（含门牌号/单元号）。不能填写邮寄地址、总部地址、海外地址或邮政信箱。须写明街道方位和单元号。

ifNone.en: This line names the US location being permitted, so there is no substitute: secure the lease or site first, then file with that address.
ifNone.zh: 此栏填写的是申请许可的美国经营地点本身，没有替代方案：请先签订租约或确定场地，再用该地址申请。

confirmations.quote: A permit is only valid for the person, location, type of food sales, or distribution activity
communicate with the health inspector assigned to the proposed food facility location.
A permit shall be valid only for the person, location, type of food sales, or distribution activity approved

what.en: The owner's own address. The form requires it to differ from the business address and not be a P.O. box; re-enter it in full. The sources do not say whether an address outside the US is accepted.
what.zh: 业主本人的地址。表格要求它不得与营业地址相同，也不得为邮政信箱；须完整填写。现有官方资料未说明是否接受美国境外地址。

ifNone.en: Give the signer's actual residential or business address. If it is abroad, Placetta asks the agency first whether a foreign address is accepted on this line.
ifNone.zh: 请填写签署人真实的住址或办公地址。如该地址在境外，Placetta 会先向该机构确认此栏是否接受境外地址。

confirmations.quote: Owner's Address (must be different than Business Address and cannot be a P.O. Box)
written application which shall state the name and address of the applicant

what.en: Where the county mails health permit invoices, with street directions and suite. Re-enter it even if it matches another line. The sources do not say whether an address outside the US is accepted.
what.zh: 县政府邮寄卫生许可账单的地址，须写明街道方位和单元号。即使与其他栏相同也须重新填写。现有官方资料未说明是否接受美国境外地址。

ifNone.en: Use a US address where mail is reliably picked up (the store once leased, or a US office or agent). Placetta asks the agency before using an address abroad.
ifNone.zh: 请使用能可靠收件的美国地址（租下门店后的门店地址，或美国办公室、代理人地址）。如需使用境外地址，Placetta 会先向该机构确认。

confirmations.quote: Billing Mailing Address (include street directions and suite number, if applicable)
such as the Billing Mailing Address, reenter that information

notes: OC Codified Ordinances 4-4-15 read through Municode's content service. The form itself says the owner's address cannot be a P.O. box and must differ from the business address, but only one source says so, so the rule stays unconfirmed with poBox not_allowed.
